stockPage.description: Business description, valuation, financials, profitability, growth, balance sheet and dividend sections for one stock.

dcfCalculator.description: Value a stock with your own assumptions and explore the sensitivity grid.

register.title: Register
register.description: Create an account with e-mail and password; return to your in-progress work.

signIn.title: Sign In
signIn.description: Authenticate with e-mail and password; your stored language preference is applied.

passwordReset.title: Password Reset
passwordReset.description: Set a new password via the e-mailed time-limited link.

accountSettings.title: Account Settings
accountSettings.description: Manage language preference, password change, saved work and account deletion.

dcfScenarios.title: My DCF Scenarios
dcfScenarios.description: Open, rename and delete your saved DCF scenarios grouped by stock.

admin.title: Admin Dashboard
admin.description: Builder-only operational surface for summary, quarantine, coverage and the run ledger.
